name: io.github.pink-agentic-payments/pink-agentic-payments-mcp
description: Pink Agentic AI Payments: a stdio MCP server that bridges any MCP client to Pink's remote payments MCP server, so AI agents can request payments checked against company spending rules (budgets, payee allow-lists, human approval) before a credential is issued. Sandbox preview, test money.

environmentVariables.name: PINK_AGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key from a Pink sandbox workspace (create one free, no signup, at https://agentic-sandbox.pinkwallet.com or via `npx pink-agentic-payments-mcp --create-sandbox`).

environmentVariables.name: PINK_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote Pink MCP endpoint to bridge to. Defaults to the public sandbox: https://agentic-sandbox.pinkwallet.com/mcp
